"""Read new normalization outputs after true worker termination; MRI stays on the server."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,json,sys,time,traceback
import numpy as np,nibabel as nib
def main():
 parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument('--run-root',type=Path,required=True);parser.add_argument('--source-root',type=Path,required=True);parser.add_argument('--output-root',type=Path,required=True);args=parser.parse_args()
 run=args.run_root;out=args.output_root;receipt=out/'independent_readback_private.json'
 assert not receipt.exists(),'Reuse completed independent readback.'
 state=json.loads((run/'status_private.json').read_text());pid=int((run/'worker.pid').read_text());active=(Path('/proc')/str(pid)/'cmdline').exists();exitcode=(run/'exit_code.txt').read_text().strip() if (run/'exit_code.txt').exists() else None
 if active or exitcode!='0' or state.get('state')!='NEW_WINDOW_NORMALIZATION_132_FEATURES_COMPLETE':
  print(json.dumps(dict(state='NOT_READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_READBACK',process_active=active,worker_state=state.get('state'),exitcode=exitcode,completed_people=state.get('completed_people'),new_array_reads=0,new_classifier_fits=0)),flush=True);return 3
 assert state['completed_people']==132 and state['new_encoder_calls']==264
 plan=json.loads((run/'plan_private.json').read_text());ids=plan['subject_ids'];assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))==132
 out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);checks=out/'people-private';checks.mkdir(exist_ok=True);records=[];vectors={'pretrained':[],'random':[]}
 position=(np.arange(360,380,dtype=np.float64)+.5)*300/750-.5;left=np.floor(position).astype(int);right=left+1;weight=position-left;lo=int(left.min());hi=int(right.max());assert (lo,hi,hi-lo+1)==(143,152,10)
 try:
  for sid in ids:
   checked=checks/(sid+'.json');folder=run/sid;path=folder/'normalized_window_private.npy';vpaths={k:folder/(k+'_288_private.npy') for k in vectors};source=args.source_root/'volume-input-v2'/sid/'resampled_2p5mm_4d_private.nii';stats={k:dict(bytes=p.stat().st_size,mtime_ns=p.stat().st_mtime_ns) for k,p in dict(source=source,normalized=path,**vpaths).items()}
   if checked.exists():
    r=json.loads(checked.read_text());assert r['source_stats']==stats,'Preserve prior verification; changed output requires investigation.'
   else:
    im=nib.load(source);assert im.shape==(96,96,96,300) and tuple(im.header.get_zooms())==(2.5,2.5,2.5,2.)
    raw=np.asarray(im.dataobj[...,lo:hi+1],dtype=np.float64);assert np.isfinite(raw).all();window=np.empty((96,96,96,20),np.float64)
    for t,(a,b,w) in enumerate(zip(left,right,weight)):window[...,t]=raw[...,a-lo]*(1-w)+raw[...,b-lo]*w
    del raw;bg=window==0;fore=window[~bg];assert fore.size>0;mean=float(fore.sum()/fore.size);std=float(np.sqrt(np.sum((fore-mean)**2)/fore.size)+1e-8);assert std>0;expected=(window-mean)/std;expected[bg]=expected[~bg].min();del fore,window,bg
    saved=np.load(path,mmap_mode='r');assert saved.shape==(96,96,96,20) and saved.dtype==np.float32 and np.isfinite(saved).all();difference=np.abs(expected-saved);maximum=float(difference.max());rmse=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(difference**2)));assert maximum<1e-4,(sid,maximum)
    producer=json.loads((folder/'result_private.json').read_text());assert producer['subject_id']==sid and producer['source_unchanged'];assert int(np.count_nonzero(saved<0))==producer['input']['new_negative_values'];assert producer['input']['source_before']==stats['source']
    samples=np.load(folder/'temporal_check_private.npz');series=samples['source_series'].astype(np.float64);independent=series[:,left]*(1-weight)+series[:,right]*weight;sample_error=float(abs(independent-samples['new_samples']).max());literal_error=float(abs(samples['literal_torch_samples']-samples['new_samples']).max());assert sample_error<1e-3 and literal_error<1e-3
    r=dict(state='NEW_WINDOW_INDEPENDENTLY_READ_BACK',subject_id=sid,source_stats=stats,finite_normalized_values=int(saved.size),maximum_float64_formula_difference=maximum,rmse=rmse,independent_32_series_maximum_difference=sample_error,saved_original_torch_32_series_difference=literal_error,source_frames_read=10,negative_values=int(np.count_nonzero(saved<0)),pooling_error_recorded_by_producer=max(x['pool_float32_vs_float64_maximum_difference'] for x in producer['branches']),encoder_not_rerun=True,raw_encoder_map_not_independently_repooled=True)
    checked.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2));del saved,expected,difference,samples
   for method,p in vpaths.items():
    v=np.load(p);assert v.shape==(288,) and v.dtype==np.float64 and np.isfinite(v).all();vectors[method].append(v)
   assert stats=={k:dict(bytes=p.stat().st_size,mtime_ns=p.stat().st_mtime_ns) for k,p in dict(source=source,normalized=path,**vpaths).items()};records.append(r);print(json.dumps(dict(verified_people=len(records),total_people=132)),flush=True)
  destination=out/'new_normalization_vectors_private.npz';assert not destination.exists();np.savez_compressed(destination,**{k:np.stack(v) for k,v in vectors.items()})
  result=dict(state='INDEPENDENT_NEW_NORMALIZATION_132_INPUTS_READ_BACK',subject_ids=ids,features_file=str(destination),feature_bytes=destination.stat().st_size,run_root=str(run),people=132,vector_values=132*288*2,finite_normalized_values=sum(r['finite_normalized_values'] for r in records),maximum_float64_normalization_difference=max(r['maximum_float64_formula_difference'] for r in records),maximum_independent_32_series_difference=max(r['independent_32_series_maximum_difference'] for r in records),maximum_recorded_pool_float32_vs_float64_difference=max(r['pooling_error_recorded_by_producer'] for r in records),source_frames_per_person=10,window_start=360,window_frames=20,raw_encoder_maps_independently_repooled=False,new_model_forwards=0,new_classifier_fits=0,patient_mri_copied_locally=0,recorded_unix=time.time());receipt.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['subject_ids','run_root','features_file']}));return 0
 except BaseException:
  (out/'failure_private.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(state='FAILED_PARTIAL_CHECKS_PRESERVED',verified_people=len(records),error=traceback.format_exc()),indent=2));raise
if __name__=='__main__':sys.exit(main())
